description:
Minimum 6 years of comprehensive experience in Java-based web / 
enterprise application development and deployment to J2EE containers 
such as Tomcat, JBOSS, or WebSphere. 


In-depth knowledge of common Java libraries such as Spring, 
Tapestry, Velocity, Hibernate, Lucene/Solr, Maven2, Cayenne, EhCache, 
Axis, etc. 


Experience with projects involving Content Management Systems similar to TeamSite, Sitecore, Day CQ, Alfresco, etc. 


Experience with Web Service technologies such as SOAP, REST, WSDL, JSON, XML, etc. 


Solid understanding of graphical web technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, XML, and Ajax.


 Skill:  CSS, Developer, Development, HTML, J2EE, Java, JavaScript, Libraries, Management, SOAP, Solr, 


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
